start: Any server request from the app (join, check-in, shop, messages, account copy) in a build with app.mettleup.fit/sb listed first

steps.action: The app sends a request; the newest address is not yet proven
user_sees: The request goes through the longest-serving address of ours; a harmless test call checks the newer one in the background
must_not: The member's request sent to an unproven address

steps.action: The test call comes back with the gym server's stamp

start: A gym logo or shop photo saved with Supabase's own address

user_sees: The picture loads through the address of ours in use now
must_not: A broken picture while Supabase's own address is blocked

start: Our address fails: no answer, a 10 s hang, or an answer without the gym server's stamp (Cloudflare's own page)

steps.action: A check-in or shop order goes out and our address fails
user_sees: The screen's own 'try again' words; the address rests for 10 minutes and the next one is used
must_not: The check-in or order sent again automatically and made twice

user_sees: Requests go straight to Supabase's own address for 10 minutes
must_not: The app stuck on a dead address

steps.action: A request after the rest ends
must_not: An address left resting forever after one failure

user_sees: The switch's memory starts fresh (proven list empty)
must_not: The saved sign-in lost because the address changed

user_sees: The Worker passes it on to the gym server unchanged
must_not: The member's sign-in or data kept or logged by the Worker beyond passing it on
